Really fun game, especially if you enjoy idle/incremental RPGs. The progression feels satisfying, and there’s a surprising amount of depth once you get into the different classes, equipment, builds, and dungeon mechanics.

I also really like how you can automate a lot of the repetitive stuff without completely taking away the fun of figuring out your own strategies. It’s the kind of game that’s easy to pick up and play for a few minutes, but also keeps you coming back to optimize your team and push further.

Great game to play casually while still having plenty to work toward. Definitely worth trying if you like dungeon crawlers, incremental games, or RPGs.

reviews.title: Great Addition to Soda Dungeon
reviews.text: Soda Dungeon 2 is an app that I have been anticipating for a while now. However, as with all apps, I had my doubts. Usually remakes are simply adding one or two features and are created to steal money from users through ridiculous in app purchases. This is not the case with Soda Dungeon 2. Soda dungeon was a cult classic and Soda Dungeon takes that legacy and multiplies it 100 fold. Not only is the art, gameplay, and styles the same, but the creators managed to expand a simple concept into something that is multidimensional. If you have not played Soda Dungeon, jumping into Soda Dungeon 2 is completely fine, as the developers have taken the time to create this game for all audiences. This game is great due to its immense detail, from the pixel art to the new Ambush mechanics. Soda dungeon 2 certainty is not a disappointment, and deserves all of the hype.

reviews.title: Fantastic Game!
reviews.text: I played the original soda dungeon a few years back, after looking at the game, I thought it looked cool, and gave it a download. What a great idea that was. The game had lots of content, the ability to remove ads with coins, with not much grinding, and it was an overall great time. When I heard about a sequel I was excited, but skeptical. Was this next game going to live up to its predecessor? So I downloaded this game when it came out, and on steam, played it a bit.. and I can say, this game for sure lives up to the hype! It adds new aspects and improves upon aspects of the previous game, and maintains the non-intrusive IAP, and the ability to remove adds with coins, permanently. So if you are looking for a fun game to play and your bored, definitely give this one a download!

In fact I don’t even care if you just copy paste enemies I just want some new biomes.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
The story in this game is utter garbage compared to the first game. Now it just feels like the player is the punchline of a very bad joke on the standard rpg formula. You didn’t even come up with anything new
(Spoiler warning)
The dark lords being fused into one evil dark lord is the exact same story we played in SD1, but you just copied and pasted that concept on the new game, only you made the bosses lame and stupid instead of actually making them remotely imposing. And 3 of the bosses (Dark Lady, Darker Lord, Darkest Lord) are just recolors of the first boss with mediocre movesets. At least the first game forces you to use nurses to heal that one boss since it’s undead, instead of this game letting idiots try to use 6 darkmages like that’s not stupid. This needs a lot of work, and maybe even a little bit of post-game content. Like for example, where is our lair of despair?

reviews.title: Pretty good but has some problems
reviews.text: Though I do enjoy this game a lot it does have some bugs. I have noticed that I never get bottle caps when I go into another dimension even though my brother get them whenever he goes into another one. I also am unable to use the bug report option in the menu. And I think that some of the tavern upgrades are very overpriced with some being worth 500 million coins when getting even 1 million is difficult. Though I think the overall design of the game is very good, it still has some problems that need to be fixed.

reviews.title: Great Game!
reviews.text: I enjoyed the first soda dungeon and this one is just as well done! I would like to see some different kind of dungeons though, seeing the first 100 dungeon monsters over and over gets boring at times. Another thing i would like to see added are some script changes! Such as for the thief, is there could be a script log so that multiple thief's aren’t using their ransack abilities on the same monster that would be awesome! Also for the Huntress and multiple uses of their Mark ability on the same monster too! All in all, a great game.

reviews.title: A game, not a lifestyle
reviews.text: More mobile games like this need to be out there. No daily logins or manufactured FOMO.  No pay 2 win nonsense. Just addictive gameplay that you can pick up or put down whenever you want. If ads annoy you, it’s a fair price to remove them. That’s it. Play it for a few weeks, throw them a few bucks, and move on with your life while remembering it fondly instead of joining a subreddit or discord just to optimize a daily grind until you burn out.

reviews.title: Fun at first, now repetitive and stale
reviews.text: I had a blast at first and paid 10 dollars to avoid ads because there are ads being shoved down your throat every single level. I cannot beat level 600 though, my team is 6 level 50 mystics with the best loot I can find and thousands of points put into relics. Even after beating my way there plus over 1,000 battle point battles. Some items are impossible to find, loot gets stale, I’ve played almost 15 hours of it since it came out and I think I maxed out on fun. I’m guessing all these 5 star reviews haven’t gotten to the level 6 boss yet cause other people have complained about it too. I wouldn’t recommend downloading unless you love repetitive grinds with mandatory ads. I will change my review once a rework/update is done.

reviews.title: Minor bug
reviews.text:
First off, I really enjoy this game. It’s a good time-killer and it has a likable, simple story line. Nothing much else to say but it’s a good game.

A minor bug I’ve encountered is, somehow, I can’t purchase the power forge. I completed the ruby quest and everything, but when I go to the carpenter, it’s nowhere to be found. I assume this power forge is crucial to progressing in the game because I’ve been stuck at level 300 for ages. I want to enjoy this game, but it’s getting  jt repetitive at this point. Please help!!

reviews.title: Fun but not finished
reviews.text: When you get to the final dimension, the scaling math on gold, relics, Items, abd survivability are broken. So it's grindy and not very rewarding until floor 3000 and then you might as well stop playing after that. It's very fun up until floor 1500 and I think that's really where they ceased development. My real complaint is that the caps buy option is next to the close button for relics with no confirmation.  On small phones that's a real problem. I spent real money and I was saving caps to unlock turning off sodas and I was curious that it was blown raising a low level relic 5 points. The next day it happened again. 200 premium caps in the trash.

reviews.title: Best mobile game ever!
reviews.text: It’s feels so good to play,no problems with anything and it’s rewarding to know what and when,it’s a good time killer with how much you can do without having to spend money for,and it has improved/added a lot of things that soda dungeon did not have,and yet it doesn’t try to confuse you with the idea of the game,just a soda dungeon crawler,I just hope that there will be a lot more but still I say the game is worth trying,but overall this game really is good and if you are just reading reviews,try it!

reviews.title: The sequel we all been waiting for.
reviews.text:
The first game was a very good concept, sequels are often cash grabs but Soda Dungeon 2 is like the original the game is completely free to play, no paying for removing ads, you can save in game money for that and other stuff, they took the first game concept slapped it on paper, then slapped more game mechanics with new ambush advantage, ores (I didnt play the first too much honestly so idk if it was In first) and more.  Same dungeon, new monsters, new heroes. Truly the sequel I have been waiting for.
:)

reviews.title: Awesome Game
reviews.text: One of the best mobile/steam games i’ve played in awhile. It has a great story with lots of funny dialogue and funny details. It also has some really good music and art. The gameplay gets a lot more advanced as you go further and further and there’s an awesome discord of awesome people who will answer your questions right away. I’m usually not a fan of idle games but the managing and strategy and custom AI of the characters make it extremely fun and addicting. 100% you should download great game and great community

reviews.title: Love this game
reviews.text: I've played both Soda Dungeons and I love them. They're funny and they have a really unique art style. Soda dungeon 2 is everything 1 was but better and with more features. I have 10 hours on this game so far on the mobile and about 1 on the pc. If there was one thing I could change it'd be a way to connect your progress to an account so you could switch from pc and mobile and not lose progress.

reviews.title: Amazing mobile game, great time waster!
reviews.text: Soda Dungeon 1 was one of my most played mobile games. It was addictive, fun, and it didn’t feel as “cashgrabby” as 95% of other mobile games. I haven’t even gotten that far into this and can already tell it’s a worthy sequel. The gameplay is simple, but rewarding, the visuals look great, and the ads/in-app purchases are very unintrusive. If you’re looking for something to pass the time, I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Great Idle game
reviews.text:
First I would like to say that the writing far exceeded expectations. It is minimal, but clever and fairly funny.

Second I would like to say this game is great at being an idle game. However, it isn’t all that much fun for active playing. If slowly leveling character and collecting loot gets your brain to give you those precious hits of dopamine, then this game is for you. If you need to be an active participant in the experience, maybe just play through the main story for the humor.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: The characters are goofy and the game is easy to understand even if you haven’t played the first. There were a few elements of character upgrades that were a little unclear, but playing through managed to show better than tell. It’s a bit repetitive and if you’re doing an auto fight there isn’t much to do but watch, and if you’re not using auto fight there still isn’t much to do. The animations are good and the colors are very nice, and I almost feel bad for the dark lord after reading his letters!

reviews.title: Fun to a point
reviews.text: I liked the first soda dungeon and still feel it’s better than this one. As far as I can tell it gets impossible to advance past dimension 6 without paying. I have been grinding in place for a week trying to beat it and still don’t appear to be close. It also has a lot of ads which I don’t mind if they aren’t overdone as a way to play for free. This has those 2 tier ads though where you watch a 30 second ad and then after it completes it makes watch a second screen for an additional timer. I can’t stand those.

reviews.title: Well worth the wait
reviews.text: I have been a long time fan of the original. This new one, while not being perfect, has added so much. It still has the soul of the first one while adding new mechanics. The story is weird, but it somehow makes sense, and the quests help you speed along. It still has some flaws, but no game is perfect. Overall, it is very enjoyable, and it’s definitely worth trying out.

reviews.title: Amazing game! But…
reviews.text: This is an amazong title with a ton of personality and and really fun mechanics to mess around with aswell. Making combos with your team is easily one of the coolest parts. My only issue at all with this title is that whenever applying the 10% gold increase in the dungeons they show banner ads. Which isnt the issue. But i would greatly appreciate if they could move the banners to the bottom. I wish to be able to see my characters aswell as my enemies moves. Small but very much wanted

reviews.title: Great game but…
reviews.text: The dark lord doesn’t seem that dark. From the 2 letters I got from him, he seems pretty nice because he politely asked us to stop raiding his dungeon. I think we should have an option to apologize to him and ask if there are any dungeons he’d recommend us going to instead, and for all we know he could be a completely different dark lord than the one we saw in the beginning.

reviews.title: This game is awesome
reviews.text: I love the soda dungeon one and I absolutely love soda dungeon too it’s amazing and in the bosses and enemies are super cool and the graphics are so nice and pixelated and it’s so good the only problem is is that the fairies that help you don’t help you that much they usually only make things worse so if I were to change anything I would change the chance of getting something good from the fairies other than that it’s awesome and I hope everyone else loves it

reviews.title: Best free to play mobile game
reviews.text: This game has made so many improvements to the first in the series, which on it’s own is fantastic, that I would consider it possibly the best free to play mobile game. The Soda Dungeon games, along with a handful of others, are some of the only mobile games that I will sink a considerable amount of time into because they are just so enjoyable. Y’all deserve more downloads and credit for this masterpiece you have made.

reviews.title: Never judge a book by its cover
reviews.text: When I first saw the name and previews of the game I genuinely thought it was probably just some cheap game made for fun. I was heavily wrong. The game is top quality, not a single bug I have spotted so far, it’s extremely fun, the lore makes me keep going, and it’s an idle game that I Don’t go idle in. This game singlehandedly your made me start enjoying retro 2d games. Please make more like these.

reviews.title: Great game bad boss
reviews.text: On Dimension eight the final boss is way to hard to stun or poison his attack that hits three people smite does way to much damage and the meditate move heals way to much health I went from killing every boss first try only losing one or two guys on the dimension 7 boss to trying two times on dimension 8 and getting him down to about 1000 health and then he just uses meditate and heals right back up to 3500 it’s very frustrating

reviews.title: 10/10 Great game, taken to heart.
reviews.text: This game is just as good as the first, and then some. I really love the style and turn-based gameplay it has to offer. I’d like to see one like this in the same art-style but this time with level based modern weapons such as guns/grenades/combat knives/bodyarmor etc. in a sort of military style replacing the sodas with different types of rations. Just an idea but this game is still one of my favorite on the App Store. Great work.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: The game is amazing. To be honest when I got the game I wasn’t expecting much because I didn’t think they could make much improvements from the first game. I was wrong. It has improved in many ways and I’m eager to see what updates are next. I hope in the future there could be a texture or something you could get that would make the game look and sound like the original.

reviews.title: I can’t stand this game any longer
reviews.text:
It’s just too good. 

But seriously, I played the first game a while ago, and it was fun but this game makes many improvements. Obviously it has the same animation style, but the dialogue I feel adds a great layer of fun to the game. The Dark Lord’s letters to the player and his lines during encounters are hilarious, just as an example. 

I’m not sure if this was in the previous game, but I love the idea that you can get rid of ads and increase the animation speed with gold. Although it does require an obscene amount of in game currency, it’s still possible to achieve without paying, which is really cool. 

The enemy designs are awesome (especially that one boss that’s just a fatass pig), and overall this game is just very enjoyable :)

reviews.title: What an excellent game!
reviews.text: I’m not big into idle games, but this one brings a party-based dungeon crawler with equipment, classes, and many upgrades to the table. It’s free and fair with its F2P model, and the pixel art is well done. Does everything I wanted it to! Pro tip, if you want to make a hard save make sure you go to options and exit to the title, otherwise you may lose progress!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: You made this game so excellent that it honestly baffles me that you don’t have more credit than you do!Keep dropping these bangers and you’re gonna have a lifelong customer. The real talk I would recommend dropping the coin value on the items that you can pay for because it takes longer to earn the 500 million then it takes to beat the game just saying

reviews.title: Still The GREATEST Mobile Game
reviews.text: I raved about the first game and here I am, raving about the second. With the same familiar play structure as the last game, the developers spice it up with new enemies, dungeon locations, characters, weapons and armor, and more! You won’t have to worry about overbearing intrusive ads and you won’t have to pour money into this game to progress. Literally the coolest little dungeon delver game you could download on your device.

reviews.title: Few bugs
reviews.text: I made it all the way to D4 after a few days of rigorous game play. Last night, it started glitching when in the dungeons by not letting me select auto play, and completely freezing after 1 manual attack. I tried using battle credits, too, but it stayed frozen on the loading screen. In an attempt to restore it, and after several tries at reloading the game, I tried to reinstall it... which consequently deleted my entire save file! It was fun while it lasted, but I’m very upset that I had to lose my file because it continually glitched in the dungeon.

reviews.title: One of the best idle games on the market
reviews.text: Good graphics and music accompany a fun storyline, in a good game. It is mostly about setting up and equipping your team, but doesn’t come off as tedious. And it’s totally possible to play the game, have loads of fun, and not pay a dime. But with a game this good it’s kind of worth it to spend a few bucks just to support the developers.

reviews.title: This is an excellent game!
reviews.text: I don’t usually write reviews but this game blew me away! I’ve played the first one and loved it and when a second one came out I thought they had either kept the game the same or changed it too much. But it’s the best of both worlds! The games mechanics are the same and I love the new crafting system!! The graphics and new bosses are a step up too! 10/10

reviews.title: Back and better than ever!
reviews.text: Absolutely loved the original for a long time. Was extremely excited to see a sequel come out. Hope to see new content in the future! (and maybe limited time events) Although I kind of miss the simpler look of the original, the sequel seems like it has way more content. Been playing for a couple of days and it’s been great.

reviews.title: Thank You!
reviews.text:
Another truly free game to play. They took all the good stuff from the first one and put more of it in there, they took the few weak points and turned them into positive points. It’s the same game but it’s not but it’s way more fun but it’s the same game but it’s not!!!!

reviews.title: Best...Series...EVER....
reviews.text:

reviews.title: Awesome game

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: The graphics are over all really nice and everything about the game is a great combo:) It’s even better that you can just save up a lot of in-game money to disable ads (which there are barely any to begin with) and get other upgrades that you would normally have to pay for in other games!

reviews.title: Great game if you’ve got time to burn
reviews.text: Read the title, this is a great game with, while not a lot of interactive gameplay at times, really makes you feel like you’re trial and erroring through a dungeon to reach your destination! If anything, this is a great game to just play when you’re bored or when u feel like u got nothing else to do!

reviews.title: Just a suggestion
reviews.text: Been a fan since the first and I’m glad y’all are adding more character to the game but could there be an original texture pack for the characters. Mainly the soda junkies I liked the way they looked in the first more tbh. Also with the ‘misunderstanding’ letter, there should be an option to write back and say sorry about that then the credits roll as if the game ended

reviews.title: First time playing and impressed!
reviews.text: Very decent game so far, I’m in dimension 3, wish there were more upgrade options for your village and some online components to visit other players would make this a 5 star game. Hopefully they will add this in the future but honestly a good game so far! Please update this often and you will make a ton of money!

reviews.title: Amazing but I have a request
reviews.text: I’d first like to say to anybody reading this I’m at level 800. and yes the level 600 boss is difficult, but I found a full team of nurses at level 25+ will do the job if you have good enough gear. My request to add something into the game is that you can equip 2 pets. I doubt this will be implemented but still. Lastly I want to thank the developers for making this game.

reviews.title: Great game but more script options needed
reviews.text: I love this game, and it’s a minor inconvenience but I wish the soda scripting could be more complex maybe for an upgrade because I really like how you can make your own auto script but I think it’s a bit too simple and I would greatly appreciate it if the developers would consider this update.

reviews.title: Meh

I can kill the first form without the chicken head items to prevent sleep but I get slaughtered by his second form.

I just don’t feel the same level of balance or challenge. It seems now at level 1,000 I should be collecting ores for crafted gear but it’s friggin boring. The game was a breeze until level 1,000 and it just seemed like a waste of time to bother mining as the lower end items were always junk.

reviews.title: I love this game.
reviews.text: I have been waiting for this game to release for years... and it has met my expectations and then some. This is a next level idle game. The customization and options keep it interesting and the corny jokes make my dad proud! You don’t need to spend any money, but I did just to support this amazing man and the work he is creating.

reviews.title: Amazing Game 10/10
reviews.text: I almost never Wright reviews for games only for 2 of them this game and the first one and they both deserved 5 stars this game is an improved version that has hours of grinding amazing to kill time has great dialage and the game itself is very fun and funny also it has an amazing story easily a 10/10 game.

reviews.title: The battle credits are great but
reviews.text: I really like the new addition of battle credits to the game, it makes you feel good because you’re getting things in the game while you’re not in game. However, I really miss the banker from soda dungeon 1 and it be really cool if you guys brought it back! The banker gives you money for the time you’re offline just like the battle credits but I would really like it if they coexisted in the game!

reviews.title: A Returner Across the Years
reviews.text: I’ve done my time in idles and this one just hits in a different way. It fullfills the whimsy, the skill, the intent, the purpose, and the constant grind satisfaction. I may linger on a zone for a bit grind for the bottle caps but in the end i know. The next challenge will require me to actually learn and or actually do something new.

reviews.title: Game is always kicking me out
reviews.text: OK I really like this game it’s one of my favorites other than raid shadow legends and basically it keeps kicking me out and I know I gave it a five star rating in but does deserve it but I don’t like the fact that it always kicks me out I mean like I think the game developers should work on kicking me out

reviews.title: Needs another way to get battle credits-otherwise great
reviews.text: It’s a really great funny game. My only complaint is the battle credit system. I do like that you can get them when not playing, but they run out so fast, and I’d like a way to either purchase with caps and/or watch ads to get them.

reviews.title: I love this game
reviews.text: I love traveling through dimensions, fighting quirky bosses and strategizing what characters use what etc. I also really like how you can customize the auto battle you can adjust it to your playsyle or even make specialized scripts for each character. I honestly can’t see why it’s a more popular game.

reviews.title: Fun Theorycrafting Game
reviews.text: I have always enjoyed the theorycrafting aspect of games like this. I LOVED Soda Dungeon for that aspect as well. SD2 does not disappoint. You build up your team with the classes you’ve unlocked, throw some gear on them, and send them off to the dungeon. You can let them run it themselves or you control the battles. Finding the right mix of team members and gear is half the fun!

reviews.title: A worthy sequel
reviews.text: This isn’t just soda dungeon with some new weapons or graphics. Soda dungeon 2 is the original soda dungeon we all love with new mechanics to add an in depth feel for the gameplay we’re used to. Soda dungeon 2 is a true sequel that can be thoroughly enjoyed even if you’ve never heard of the first game. I’m excited to see the new levels, enemies, characters, and weapons in this amazing sequel.

reviews.title: Hit or Miss
reviews.text: It’s a hit or miss like the first version. While the concept of this dungeon crawler is simple yet enjoyable, it doesn’t provide much more than the first few dimensions. Heck. The gameplay repeats itself once personalized scripts are unlocked in the 2nd dimension. Crafting is a joke, showing real application to after the campaign. Additionally, as an idle game that requires the device to be on, you will drain your battery for playing. Both mobile and PC versions of this game heat up the device as much as games with high graphics.

reviews.title: Game hits the sweet spot
reviews.text: This is only the second of dozeons of iPad games I bothered to finish. Most of them stiffen up quickly and you can't progress without sending in ridiculous amounts of cash. This one you can play for free, and if you send them 5 or ten bucks, you can speed it up. Totally reasonable, totally fun, totally charming, classic grind-and-farm RPG. Well done, guys.

reviews.title: Fun game BUT
reviews.text: The game is fun and enjoyable overall. HOWEVER it’s pretty disappointing that don’t matter how many floors you go up you fight the same monsters every 100 floors. I was thinking ok maybe there will be new ones on floors 500 or maybe 1000 but nope. So there for that’s pretty much the stopping point. Gets boring very quick after you find that out.

reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text: There’s a lot of improvement over the first one, having an additional character is great. My biggest complaint is the quick battle, I think it ruins the game in a lot of ways. I like the feeling like I actually earned my stuff in games but the main reason I think it should be removed because my points are maxed out and that annoying icon is always there wanting me to claim more and it just makes me frustrated.

reviews.title: You did it again

This game is an absolute joy. Simple yet can be very strategic if you want to make it a long way. I LOVE these games. Keep it up! I’ll never stop playing.

reviews.title: Love it so much

reviews.title: Very good improvement from the first game!

reviews.title: So close to 5 stars… just missing one feature.
reviews.text:
First off, this is the best sequel since revenge of the sith - I have already sunk over 40 hours into this game, it’s amazing to leave on all day at work because my dungeons are usually just about done by break time. 

But here’s the beef. 

Please make it so that when you are setting up your ‘Soda Scripts’, you can select specific statuses like cursed/stone/poisoned. This one little thing is what makes scripts so limiting, especially when it comes to auto-buffing your team, or if you want to set up a sequence of moves that all are different debuffs. 

Otherwise, love the game!

reviews.title: I have one major complaint
reviews.text:
Please make it where my pen pal (the dark lord), we can help him. I mean he’s such a chill and nice guy, but we are forced to be mean to him to progress the game. Please make it where we can go against an arrogant light lord or something, because I don’t want to hurt my little dark friend.

Thank you for your consideration

reviews.title: Smallish bug
reviews.text: Love your game it’s sooooooo much fun but found a smallish bug that makes the game a bit too much easier. After defeating a boss if you tap just directly under any of the chests it opens all three for you giving you all three rewards. Just wanted you to know. Thanks for creating an amazing game!

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text: This is a great game. If you guys can make it so I can collect rewards even if you do not have ads available it would be even better. I still love this game but it’s starting to get difficult to get things hidden behind ad walls

reviews.title: Amazing, love your work
reviews.text: I used to play Soda Dungeon 1 a lot, and never knew there was a sequel. This game is amazing, everything you do in this series works so well and feels wonderful. The art is absolutely stunning, the game loop feels rewarding, it’s right up my alley. Thank you for such an experience

reviews.title: Games not being developed anymore ?
reviews.text:

reviews.title: Repetitive idle game
reviews.text:
Forget the sales pitch about tactics being important. This game is extremely repetitive and makes no apology about it. 

The bulk of the game is going through the same 100 levels repeatedly, then going to another difficulty and reacquiring your items, farming resources in an unending rat race. 

The idea that faster animations are a premium option is a ludicrous testament to the fact: it’s more of an idle game than a real game. 

I gave it 2 stars instead of 1 for the great music.

Great little idle adventure full of weird gear and surprises. It has 100 unique floors that repeat indefinitely and tons of new upgrades.

Since the game won’t run in the background, you’re required to leave the game open for tens of hours, rendering your phone worthless for nonsensical amounts of time, resulting in constant losses of progress due to needing to take calls or just from killing your battery outright.
  Honestly, if you’re going to make an idler, at least find a way to run while minimized instead of demanding it be the only thing open on a device you need for everyday life. Great sequel though, enjoying it quite a bit!
